A weighted combination approach with dynamic error adaptation is recommended to handle the drifting performance and high variability in model accuracy.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift requires recency-weighted methods like ADE dynamic error weighting
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.0994) → soft combiners with shrinkage (0.35) are more robust to unstable rankings
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.noise.level=high → trimmed mean (10% trim) mitigates outlier model errors in high-noise environments

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p2_sh0.0: series_profile.model_landscape.models_redundant=false → hierarchical stacking is less effective when models are not redundant
